title: GPT-4 Developer Livestream
summary: OpenAI's livestream demo of GPT-4 with Greg Brockman, showing its capabilities and limitations. Highlights include writing code, turning a hand-drawn sketch into a website, and a tax-question example.
why: HN refers back to it as the primary source for what GPT-4 could do at launch, especially the sketch-to-website and multimodal demos.
